tasks.title: Validate build
tasks.notes: Run pnpm install, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build. Fix all errors before any new feature work.

tasks.title: Add interactive mission sandbox (client-only)
tasks.notes: Add a lightweight interactive visual with scenario presets; avoid any implication of spacecraft control.

tasks.title: Add a pilot request page
tasks.notes: Create a dedicated /pilot route with clear scope, guardrails, and contact workflow.

tasks.title: Add an investor page
tasks.notes: Create /investor with crisp positioning, market pull, and technical credibility. Keep product truth strict.

tasks.title: Add technical benchmark section
tasks.notes: Add methodology-first benchmarks and disclaimers; avoid fake performance/flight claims.

tasks.title: Add structured content data file
tasks.notes: Move homepage copy/features/use-cases into a structured TS/JSON file for maintainability.

tasks.title: Improve SEO
tasks.notes: Add OpenGraph metadata, canonical URL when domain exists, and consider sitemap/robots if needed.

tasks.title: Run safe disk cleanup after build validation
tasks.notes: After successful build, remove node_modules and build artifacts per cleanup policy; preserve src/public/config/.autobuilder.
